translation.name: Selections from Luke, Mark, Acts, Genesis, Ruth, and Romans

content: Kalu-wingka bajinju barrawula Jirriku, Jijaj marda li-jawina likungu; kalu-lhuwarri bajingu li-mangaji marda nalumiji nakaringu winkanda. Bajiwa mirningiya mingkiya rru-yabala na-wini Bardimiyaj, nyiki-ardu ki-Dimiyaj, kabuji ka-arri, bajiwa mingkiya yukulyukulmantharra alunga yalbanganthawu mu-maniyu.

Ngaliwa kalila-yngkarri li-wulu kalu-wukanyi, “Marniwa Jijaj jibiya Najarrida”, baki yiwa ka-wajba, “Jijaj, nyiki-nganji ki-Dabida, rarriya ngatha nda-wurdu!” Li-wulu kalu-mirirri yiku, kalu-arri, “Lhaba anmaya!” Ngaliwa wajbantharra mili kurdandu, “Nyiki-nganji ki-Dabida, rarriya ngatha nda-wurdu!”

Kulu kumba-wama alarrinjarra, kumba-yngkalayngkarri yiku Jijaj, ka-arri alunga, “Nyirri-naya wa-wingkaya” Kulu kalu-wajba ki-kabujiyu yiku, kalu-wukanyi, “Yamulu barra, alarriyal Ja-wajbanji yinku Jijaj wingkaya yilalu!”
Kili-nma jumbal a lhangka nya-mangaji kilu-walima wajkaliya, ka-alarri yarlayka, ka-wingka yilalu ki-Jijaj.
Kilu-yalbanga ki-Jijaj, “Ngandarra karna-arrila yinku?” Ka-arri yiku kabuji, “Wirdi, nganha-yabimaya ngarna-mi, ngarna nganthawu awara!”

Ka-arri yiku Jijaj, “Lhuwarriya ngantharra awara! Kinya-ngala barra kangka kinyamba-yibarra nda-wurdu ngathangka.” Yinarrambalulu barra ka-yabirri na-mi, kila-kala awara yabi barra; kulu kilu-wanda Jijaj rru-yabala. Bawuji barra.
